# doit_user_notification (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "doit_user_notification" "anomaly" {
  user_id = "user_01H..."

  name = "Anomaly alerts"

  settings = {
    cost_anomalies = {
      min_severity = "warning"
      min_excess_cost = {
        amount   = "100.00"
        currency = "USD"
      }
      allocations = {
        mode = "include"
        ids  = ["alloc_abc", "alloc_def"]
      }
      # Omit `repeat` entirely when neither resend control is used.
      repeat = {
        every_hours = 24
        when_cost_grows = {
          # Required when both percent_increase and min_increase are set.
          match            = "or"
          percent_increase = 10
          min_increase = {
            amount   = "50.00"
            currency = "USD"
          }
          # Omit within_hours when the growth time window is off.
          within_hours = 12
        }
      }
    }
  }

  timeouts = {
    create = "5m"
    read   = "5m"
    update = "5m"
    delete = "5m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the new notification config.
- `settings` (Attributes) Subscribed notification settings. Only `costAnomalies` is accepted.
Settings for any other type are rejected; omitting `costAnomalies` is
rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `user_id` (String) The unique ID of the user. Must belong to the tenant resolved from
the bearer token and optional `X-Tenant-Id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the config was created. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `destinations` (Attributes List) Server-managed destinations. Always one email entry with the target
user's address. `conditions` is always present; when the caller
omitted it, the value is `null`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `etag` (String) Current strong ETag. Send it unchanged in `If-Match` on update or
delete. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned notification id. `null` only on a dry-run create.
- `notification_id` (String) The unique ID of the notification config returned by create or list.
- `update_time` (String) When the config was last changed. `null` only on a dry-run create.

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `cost_anomalies` (Attributes) Cost-anomaly notification settings: minimum severity, excess-cost
threshold, allocation scope, and optional resend controls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies`

Required:

- `allocations` (Attributes) Allocation scope for cost-anomaly notifications. `ids` are allocation
ids from `GET /analytics/v1/allocations`. An id outside the caller's
tenant is rejected with `422` without saying whether it exists
elsewhere.

`mode: all` means every allocation with anomaly detection enabled,
including anomalies that are not tied to an allocation, and it carries
an empty `ids`. `include` and `exclude` require at least one id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations))
- `min_excess_cost` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost))
- `min_severity` (String) `all` — all severity levels. `warning` — warning and above.
`critical` — critical only. There is no `information` value.

Possible values: `all`, `warning`, `critical`

Optional:

- `repeat` (Attributes) Resend controls for an active cost anomaly. Omit the whole `repeat`
object when neither control is set. An empty object is rejected with
`422`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--allocations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.allocations`

Required:

- `ids` (List of String) Allocation ids. Empty when `mode` is `all`. Non-empty when `mode`
is `include` or `exclude`.
- `mode` (String) `all` — every allocation with anomaly detection enabled (and
unallocated anomalies). `include` — only the listed ids.
`exclude` — all enabled allocations except the listed ids.

Possible values: `all`, `include`, `exclude`


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--min_excess_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.min_excess_cost`

Required:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat`

Optional:

- `every_hours` (Number) Resend until the anomaly is inactive, every N hours (1–24).
- `when_cost_grows` (Attributes) Resend when the anomaly's cost grows:

- both `percentIncrease` and `minIncrease` present → `match` is
  required (`or` or `and`)
- exactly one of `percentIncrease` or `minIncrease` present → omit
  `match` (percentage-only or value-only)
- neither amount present → rejected with `422`

`percentIncrease` is an integer percent (`10` means 10 percent).
Omit `withinHours` when the time window is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows`

Optional:

- `match` (String) How to combine percent and dollar growth when both are set.
Required when both amounts are present; omit when only one amount
is present.

Possible values: `or`, `and`
- `min_increase` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase))
- `percent_increase` (Number) Minimum percent cost increase that triggers a resend. `10` means
10 percent.
- `within_hours` (Number) Optional window in hours for the growth check (1–24).

<a id="nestedatt--settings--cost_anomalies--repeat--when_cost_grows--min_increase"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.cost_anomalies.repeat.when_cost_grows.min_increase`

Required:

- `amount` (String) Decimal monetary amount at ISO 4217 minor-unit precision (string).
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code.






<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Target user's email, copied by the server.
- `type` (String) Delivery channel. Personal delivery is email only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the composite ID: user_id/notification_id.
terraform import doit_user_notification.test '<user-id>/<notification-id>'
```
